verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid is itself a coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and the server-side story does not apply to it. The MCP evidence is client-side: connecting MCP tools to Droid sessions and the CLI. The probe pointing to /harness/mcp gives no explicit description of Droid running as an MCP server (no serve subcommand and no hosted MCP endpoint), so it does not make this axis applicable.
